FN-RZHKMNM-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 66
Committee: Ports, Waterways, & Intermodal Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Transit
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/13/2024
House Bill 66 as introduced would provide that all fines and other monies collected from food
service establishments violating country of origin labeling requirements for certain seafood shall
be distributed to the Alabama Department of Public Health to implement this program. This bill
will not otherwise affect state or local funding.

FN-RZHKMNM-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 66
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/14/2024
House Bill 66 as passed the House of Representatives would provide that all fines and other
monies collected from food service establishments violating country of origin labeling
requirements for certain seafood shall be distributed to the Alabama Department of Public
Health to implement and enforce the provisions of this bill. This bill will not otherwise affect
state or local funding.
